resources.string: The final outcome of a request is unconfirmed: the service may have received and charged for it. This job is stopped: Retry cannot resend it. You can read the results already received. A new request from the recording requires an explicit choice and may cost again; uncertain charges stay protected.

These are only the results received by this job: you can select and copy the text. This is not a complete transcript. Time ranges describe the uploaded audio window, not word timings. Saved history and the selected version are preserved.

Results are being checked or are unavailable for this account and version of the recording. Retained files are neither deleted nor resent. If the account or audio changed, return to the original version to recover them.
No result received: this portion is missing.
Response not saved; request outcome uncertain. This portion is missing and will not be resent automatically.
Retained result cannot be verified against this audio or plan. It has not been included or resent.

The service may already have received and charged for a part. This is a new transcription and could charge again for parts already received. The old job stays stopped, its results remain recoverable, and uncertain charges are not released. Continue with the normal checks for a new request?
Clear history keeps jobs with results or uncertain requests. Delete on an individual job removes its local recovery access.
